title: SAIC connection to Crane
summary: Jesse Michels tells of SAIC connection to Crane, about unspecified at Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana

tellings.quote: our friend UAP gerb has dug up a lot of research around saic's work with Crane

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that an online researcher who goes by UAP Gerb has dug up a lot of material about the work of SAIC, a large American defence contracting company, with Crane, a Navy weapons research base in Indiana. He does not spell out what that work was. He raises it because, if the link holds, it would point to a contractor and a Navy base working together on something tied to the UFO story.
